submission.justification: Based on comprehensive simulation results across all three candidate materials and plate thicknesses from 2-10 mm, Absorber-F3 with 4 mm plate thickness delivers the best energy resolution at 100 GeV (3.154%). This represents a significant improvement over Absorber-F1's best resolution of 3.96% at 4 mm, and substantially better than Absorber-F2's best resolution of 5.139% at 4 mm. All three materials meet the critical radiation safety constraint (residual dose rate < 20 µSv/h at 1 m after one week of cooldown), making F3 the clear choice for optimizing detector performance while maintaining safe operational conditions for hands-on maintenance.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV
requirements.evidence: F3 at 4 mm achieves 3.154% resolution, which is the best among all tested configurations. This is 20% better than F1's best (3.96%) and 39% better than F2's best (5.139%).

requirements.requirement: The absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F3 is one of the three candidate materials evaluated (F1, F2, F3).

requirements.requirement: The residual dose rate at 1 m after one week of cooldown must not exceed 20 uSv/h
requirements.evidence: F3 meets the dose constraint (F3_meets_dose_constraint = 1), along with all other candidates.
Recommended thickness of 4 mm is within the allowed range of 2-10 mm.

requirements.requirement: Submit one recommended material and plate thickness
requirements.evidence: Recommending Absorber-F3 with 4 mm plate thickness.
